segments.en: We learned in the mishna that there is a dispute between Rabbi Akiva and the Rabbis in a case where one threw an object «from the private domain to the» other «private domain» through the public domain between the two. Rabbi Akiva deems him liable, as one who threw an object from the private domain to the public domain, and the Rabbis deem him exempt.
